component.name: GoshLauncher
component.summary: Qt 6 and KDE Kirigami application launcher

description.p: GoshLauncher opens with Ctrl+Space and searches applications, files, folders, bookmarks, windows, settings, calculations, units, colors, URLs, and the web.
It uses Qt 6 and KDE Kirigami, follows the desktop color scheme, and keeps compatibility with Ulauncher extension API 3.0 and existing user data.

ul.li: Adds native Fedora RPM packaging using distribution Qt, Kirigami, and Python dependencies.
Preserves the canonical application identity, commands, extension API, and existing user paths.
Promotes the Qt 6 and KDE Kirigami rewrite to its first stable release.
Adopts com.goshapps.GoshLauncher as the permanent catalog and desktop identity.
Preserves Ulauncher-era settings, extensions, commands, and data paths for rollback.
